```{r setup, include=FALSE}

```

```{r, results='asis', echo=FALSE}
cat("Team name:  ..........................................................................\n\n")
cat("Members:  ............................................................................\n\n")
cat("The programme you are evaluating:  ....................................................\n\n")

cat("\\newpage\n\n")
cat("# Part 1. Where your design stands\n\n")
cat("You started this design in Module 1. Before adding anything, write down the design as it\n")
cat("stands now. If you do not have the Module 1 document to hand, use the recap below to\n")
cat("reconstruct it \u2014 the eight conditions have not changed.\n\n")

for (i in seq_len(nrow(design_conditions))) {
  cat(sprintf("**%d. %s.** *%s*\n\n", i, design_conditions$condition[i],
              design_conditions$recap[i]))
  cat("Your design:  ......................................................................\n\n")
  cat("......................................................................................\n\n")
}

cat("\\newpage\n\n")
cat("# Part 2. The four additions\n\n")
cat("This is the new work. Each addition comes from a session this week.\n\n")

for (i in seq_len(nrow(design_additions))) {
  cat(sprintf("## %d. %s\n\n", i, design_additions$addition[i]))
  cat(sprintf("*From: %s*\n\n", design_additions$from[i]))
  cat(sprintf("%s\n\n", design_additions$asks[i]))
  cat("......................................................................................\n\n")
  cat("......................................................................................\n\n")
  cat("......................................................................................\n\n")
  cat("......................................................................................\n\n")
  if (i < nrow(design_additions)) cat("\\newpage\n\n")
}

cat("\\newpage\n\n")
cat("# Part 3. Your five-minute pitch\n\n")
cat("One pitch per team. Five minutes, then three minutes of feedback from the room.\n\n")
for (i in seq_len(nrow(pitch_structure))) {
  cat(sprintf("- **%s** *(%s).* %s\n", pitch_structure$part[i],
              pitch_structure$minutes[i], pitch_structure$says[i]))
}
cat("\n")
cat("## The one rule\n\n")
cat("Say what your design **cannot** establish before you say what you want. A pitch that\n")
cat("names its own limit is more persuasive, not less: it tells the room which parts you have\n")
cat("already thought about.\n\n")
cat("## Notes\n\n")
cat("......................................................................................\n\n")
cat("......................................................................................\n\n")
cat("......................................................................................\n\n")
```
